fields.title: Blibli review / store summary record
fields.description: Two record shapes, discriminated by `recordType`. REVIEW carries one buyer review with Blibli's own fields passed through verbatim plus flattened fields for AI pipelines. STORE_SUMMARY carries one aggregate per target: rating histogram, negative/positive share, and Blibli's topic counts across the store's entire review base. ERROR carries a diagnostic row when a target fails. Every type is declared nullable because which fields are populated depends on the record type.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The store/product/brand identifier that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-public-reviews, S2-review-summary, or none on failure.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failure rows (INVALID_TARGET, BLOCKED_AFTER_RETRIES, UPSTREAM_SHAPE_CHANGED, INVALID_INPUT, EMPTY_RESULT).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

targetValue.title: Target value
targetValue.description: The resolved store code, product SKU, or brand name.

merchantName.title: Store name
merchantName.description: Display name of the store, resolved from its catalogue listing.

id.title: Review ID
id.description: Blibli's review identifier, used to deduplicate across coverage sweeps.

name.title: Reviewer name
name.description: Reviewer display name. Blibli returns it already masked (e.g. 'M***a'); this actor never attempts to unmask it.

content.title: Review content
content.description: The review text exactly as Blibli returns it.

reviewText.title: Review text
reviewText.description: Same as `content`, surfaced at a stable top-level name for LLM/embedding pipelines.

reviewLength.title: Review length
reviewLength.description: Character count of the review text - useful for filtering out one-word reviews before an AI pass.

hasText.title: Has text
hasText.description: False for star-only reviews with no written content.

ratingPolarity.title: Rating polarity
ratingPolarity.description: negative (1-2 stars), neutral (3), or positive (4-5). Derived directly from the star rating - this is NOT natural-language sentiment analysis, it is a cheap pre-filter so an LLM pass can be spent only on the reviews that matter.

verifiedBuyer.title: Verified buyer
verifiedBuyer.description: Whether Blibli marks the reviewer as having actually purchased the item.

likes.title: Likes
likes.description: How many shoppers marked this review helpful.

edited.title: Edited
edited.description: Whether the reviewer edited the review after posting.

productSku.title: Product SKU
productSku.description: Which product the review is about - present even on store-wide sweeps, so reviews can be grouped by product.

hasMedia.title: Has media
hasMedia.description: Whether the review carries any photo or video.

createdAtIso.title: Created at
createdAtIso.description: UTC ISO 8601 time the review was posted.

updatedAtIso.title: Updated at
updatedAtIso.description: UTC ISO 8601 time the review was last edited.

matchedTopic.title: Matched topic
matchedTopic.description: Set when the review was surfaced by a topic sweep (coverage 'maximum'), meaning Blibli classifies it under that topic: QUALITY, PRICE, SHIPMENT, PACKAGING, SERVICE, ORIGINALITY or GENERIC.

matchedRatingFilter.title: Matched rating filter
matchedRatingFilter.description: Set when the review was surfaced by a per-rating sweep, recording which rating slice found it.

totalReviews.title: Total reviews
totalReviews.description: STORE_SUMMARY. Total public reviews Blibli holds for the target - typically far more than any single run can page through.

averageRating.title: Average rating
averageRating.description: STORE_SUMMARY. Mean star rating across the entire review base.

maxRating.title: Max rating
maxRating.description: STORE_SUMMARY. Top of the rating scale (5).

ratingCounts.title: Rating histogram
ratingCounts.description: STORE_SUMMARY. Review count per star level, keyed '1' to '5', across the entire review base.

negativeSharePercent.title: Negative share %
negativeSharePercent.description: STORE_SUMMARY. Percentage of all rated reviews that are 1-2 star. The headline number for tracking whether a store's sentiment is deteriorating.

positiveSharePercent.title: Positive share %
positiveSharePercent.description: STORE_SUMMARY. Percentage of all rated reviews that are 4-5 star.

commentCount.title: Comment count
commentCount.description: STORE_SUMMARY. Number of reviews carrying written text.

topicCounts.title: Topic counts
topicCounts.description: STORE_SUMMARY. Blibli's own classification of what reviewers talk about, counted across the entire review base: QUALITY, PRICE, SHIPMENT, PACKAGING, SERVICE, ORIGINALITY, GENERIC. This is the 'what do customers keep bringing up' signal without needing an AI pass.

topicLabels.title: Topic labels
topicLabels.description: STORE_SUMMARY. Human-readable label for each topic code, so consumers need not hardcode the translation.
